column1: # FlexSearch product lines (v2.42): a brand's named product lines, as customers search them ("lochinvar knight",
# "bosch greenstar", "toto drake"). Lines the catalog lists are also read from its own series attribute; this file adds
# the ones customers type that the catalog may not list, and the kind of product each line is, so a line the catalog
# doesn't have still finds that brand's products of that kind ("No Knight line here. These are Lochinvar boilers.").
#   note   (optional) what the page says instead of the standard line notice
#   kind   "none": nothing here stands in for it (a different system), so the page shows nothing and says why
#   alone  yes: the line names the brand by itself ("greenstar" is Bosch); no: only after the brand ("knight" alone is
#          too common a word); generic: the trade uses the name for the product type ("propress" is any copper press
#          fitting), so alone it searches the kind without holding the brand

column6: MegaPress is Viega's press system for steel pipe, and the demo catalog has no steel press fittings. Copper press fittings don't fit steel pipe; ask your branch for MegaPress.

column1: # v2.44: model series people type as the product (the Oct 25 trade-vocabulary probes)

column6: Well-X-Trol is Amtrol's well pressure tank, and the demo catalog has no well tanks. Ask your branch for Well-X-Trol.
Monoflo is Bell & Gossett's diverter tee for one-pipe hot-water systems, and the demo catalog has none. Ask your branch for Monoflo tees.
